public.title: Find the Duplicate Number
public.description: values contains n+1 integers, each from 1 through n, with exactly one distinct value repeated two or more times. Return that value. n is 1 to 1000. Input mutation is optional; try constant auxiliary space as an extension.
hints: Treat each value as a next-index pointer.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The index chain must enter a cycle, whose entry is the duplicated value. Floyd cycle detection finds it in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
